title: Discovering Differences in the Representation of People using Contextualized Semantic Axes

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting contextualized BERT embeddings of gendered terms (e.g., 'women', 'femoids') and their surrounding contexts (via counterfactual substitution with 'person') onto constructed semantic axes to measure shifts in misogynistic and dehumanizing language over time.
Projecting contextualized embeddings of occupation terms from Wikipedia onto semantic axes to measure semantic associations and conceptual differences across various job categories.
